blocks.text: CITY OF SAN JOSE DEL MONTE, Bulacan — The owners and employees of a pet crematorium in Cavite are facing charges for allegedly dumping the remains of 25 animals in a village in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. The alleged act violated Republic Act No. 9003, or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, and the city’s sanitation ordinance. City police chief Col. Nelson Sardin said barangay officials and residents of Barangay Minuyan initially buried the remains of 22 dogs and three cats on Saturday morning, Oct. 31.
